songs.title: Faithfulness
songs.songwriter: Justin Yglesias (quotes the hymn Great Is Thy Faithfulness by Thomas Chisholm / William Runyan, 1923)
songs.matchNotes: On Justin's Flourish album, Faithfulness is an original that quotes the hymn Great Is Thy Faithfulness. Not confirmed by Justin for this set the way Open My Heart's Eyes and The Potter were. Album chord chart exists in D (wrong key for this set) and was not copied. No official recording; YouTube left blank. Confirm with Justin whether this is the Flourish original or another song titled Faithfulness.
